<SandboxIntro description={[
  {
    "text": "The Arista AVD sandbox is a working example of building Arista data center fabrics with AVD, with Infrahub as the source of truth. You describe a fabric with its pods and racks, the number of switches in each and the address pools to use, and Generators create the switches, cabling, IP addresses and BGP settings. PyAVD then generates the structured configuration of each switch, and Infrahub renders its EOS configuration and documentation. It is set up for teams that run AVD from variable files and want a source of truth, a web interface and branch-based review around it."
  }
]} status={"available"} endpoints={[

## What's in the sandbox

<SandboxBlocks blocks={[
  {
    "p": [
      {
        "text": "The sandbox contains example Arista fabrics, including Fabric-L3LS-MultiPod-A, with their pods, racks and address pools. Its Service Catalog is a web form for day-2 changes: adding a network segment, adding a server or creating a tenant."
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "p": [
      {
        "text": "The design follows a two-phase pipeline: Infrahub Generators create the topology from the design, then PyAVD runs inside Infrahub to generate each switch's structured configuration. From that data, Infrahub renders EOS configurations, Markdown documentation for each switch and fabric, and a cabling plan as artifacts."
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "p": [
      {
        "text": "The sandbox does not include the Ansible and Semaphore deployment, the ANTA tests or Containerlab, because they need devices that the sandbox cannot reach. CloudVision validation does not run either."
      }
    ]
  }
]} />

![When you log in, the main branch holds one fabric, Fabric-L3LS, with one pod, sdc-l3ls-pod1. The Generators have already created its six Arista switches: the spines spine-sdc-l3ls-pod1-1 and spine-sdc-l3ls-pod1-2, and four leaf switches in two MLAG pairs. Each leaf switch has one uplink to each spine. Rack SDC_L3LS_BORDER holds leaf-sdc-l3ls-pod1-1-1, leaf-sdc-l3ls-pod1-1-2 and the server sdc-l3ls-server1. Rack SDC_L3LS_ACCESS holds leaf-sdc-l3ls-pod1-2-1, leaf-sdc-l3ls-pod1-2-2 and the servers sdc-l3ls-server2 and sdc-l3ls-gpu1. The EVPN tenant SDC-L3LS-TENANT has the VRF SDC-VRF10 and the VLANs 11, 12 and 21. Each switch has an AVD EOS Configuration artifact.](./img/demo-arista-avd.svg)
